title: Starbursts with suppressed velocity dispersion revealed in a forming cluster at z = 2.51
question: What is the role of dense environments and the detailed physical mechanisms in triggering starburst activities in high-redshift forming galaxy clusters?

recipe.goal: Measure CO(3-2) and 3.2 mm dust continuum source sizes
recipe.method: Fit an elliptical Gaussian to visibility CO(3-2) data in the UV plane using uvmodelfit, and perform 2D elliptical Gaussian fits on high-resolution Moment 0 maps of CO(3-2) and 3.2 mm continuum in the image plane
assumptions: Lack of significant size variation between CO and dust continuum when comparing with literature

recipe.goal: Measure CO(3-2) flux, luminosity, and CO excitation R_31
recipe.method: Perform 2D Gaussian fitting on the velocity-integrated intensity map (Moment 0) to get CO(3-2) flux, convert to L'_CO(3-2), and divide by JVLA L'_CO(1-0) to obtain R_31

recipe.goal: Derive dust mass, total infrared luminosity, and SFR via IR SED fitting
recipe.method: Fit multi-wavelength infrared photometry from 24 um to 3.2 mm using CIGALE with a two-component dust emission model and test for AGN contribution
assumptions: Chabrier (2003) IMF, Draine (2014) dust model, Fritz (2006) AGN template

recipe.goal: Estimate molecular gas masses, gas fractions, and depletion times using three independent methods
recipe.method: Calculate M_gas from (i) CO(1-0) luminosity with metallicity-dependent alpha_CO(Z), (ii) M_dust with metallicity-dependent gas-to-dust ratio delta_GDR, and (iii) 3.2 mm Rayleigh-Jeans dust continuum following Scoville et al. (2016)
assumptions: Helium correction factor of 1.36; PP04 metallicity scale with 0.15 dex uncertainty; RJ-tail parameters: beta = 1.8, T_d = 25 K, alpha_850 = 6.7e19 erg s^-1 Hz^-1 M_sun^-1 (corresponding to alpha_CO = 6.5)

recipe.goal: Model 3D molecular gas kinematics to derive V_max and sigma_0
recipe.method: Fit the 0.3'' resolution CO(3-2) data cubes with a 3D Bayesian parametric disk model convolved with the 3D PSF and LSF using GalPAK^3D
key_parameters: 10 free parameters (x_c, y_c, z_c, Flux, r_1/2, r_v, Incl., PA, V_max, sigma_0); 20,000 MCMC iterations; last 30% chain fraction used
assumptions: Thick exponential-disk light profile and arctan rotational velocity curve V_rot propto V_max arctan(r/r_v)

recipe.goal: Evaluate gravitational stability of the gas disks via Toomre Q parameter
recipe.method: Calculate Toomre Q = kappa * sigma_0,gas / (pi * G * Sigma_gas) using kinematic parameters and the three gas mass estimates
assumptions: Flat rotation curve with epicyclic frequency kappa = sqrt(2) * V_max / r_1/2

score_reason: Calibration, array combination weights, pixel sizes, channel widths, weighting schemes, and kinematic modeling tools/assumptions are clearly specified, and all key output quantities are tabulated. Minor deductions for missing tclean stopping criteria, exact continuum line-free channel ranges, and GalPAK^3D prior bounds.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA dataset (2016.1.01155.S), well-defined recipe from calibrated visibilities to 3D kinematic modeling with public software (CASA, CIGALE, GalPAK^3D), and comprehensive numeric tables for fluxes, sizes, masses, V_max, and sigma_0.
